# gsm_project_autoscaling_group (Data Source)

Reads an autoscaling group owned by a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gsm_project_autoscaling_group" "default" {
  project_id             = "<project_id>"
  autoscaling_group_name = "docs-asg"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `autoscaling_group_name` (String) Name of the autoscaling group
- `project_id` (String) Project ID where the autoscaling group belongs

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `targets` (List of Object) Clusters that game servers of this group are scaled onto (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `default` (String)

Read-Only:

- `max_pods` (Number)
- `weight` (Number)
